Residual-kriging bias correction of a prediction raster, end to end

Source: R/spatial_bias_reduction.R
reduce_spatial_bias.Rd

The single entry point for the correction pipeline. Given points carrying signed residuals (from point_residuals), it fits a variogram, krige the residuals onto newdata (optionally as a bootstrap ensemble for uncertainty), and adds the resulting correction surface back onto pred. When the residuals show no spatial structure (a pure-nugget variogram) there is nothing to interpolate: the function warns and returns pred unchanged.

Usage

reduce_spatial_bias(
  points,
  newdata,
  pred = newdata,
  resid = "resid",
  aoa = NULL,
  aoa_thresh = 1,
  bootstrap = FALSE,
  n = 199,
  cores = NULL,
  vgm_model = "Exp",
  nugget_cut = 0.9,
  clamp = c(0, 1),
  outside = c("keep", "na"),
  seed = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

points

An sf point layer carrying a residual column (see point_residuals).

newdata

Where to krige the correction: an sf point layer or, more usually, a coarse terra SpatRaster template. Kriging every cell of a fine grid is expensive, so keep this coarser than pred.

pred

A SpatRaster of predicted suitability to correct. Defaults to newdata when that is itself a raster.

resid

Name of the residual column (default "resid").

aoa

Area-of-applicability restricting where the correction is produced: a SpatRaster dissimilarity-index (DI) surface (in-AOA where di <= aoa_thresh, the package convention) or an sf/SpatVector polygon. NULL predicts everywhere in newdata.

aoa_thresh

In-domain DI threshold for a raster aoa (default 1).

bootstrap

Whether to build the correction as a point-resampling ensemble (n draws) rather than a single kriging. The ensemble mean is used as the correction and its standard deviation is returned for uncertainty.

n

Number of bootstrap resamples when bootstrap = TRUE.

cores

Worker processes for the bootstrap (see bootstrap_correction); ignored unless bootstrap = TRUE.

vgm_model

Variogram model form to fit, e.g. "Exp", "Sph".

nugget_cut

Nugget-to-sill ratio at or above which the field is treated as pure nugget (no spatial structure) and left uncorrected.

clamp

Range to clamp the corrected values to (default c(0, 1); NULL to skip).

outside

What to do where the correction is NA (outside the AOA): "keep" the original prediction (default) or "na" to blank it.

seed

Optional RNG seed for the bootstrap.

...

Passed to krige (e.g. nmax).

Value

A list with corrected (the corrected SpatRaster), correction (the kriged correction surface, or NULL when pure nugget) and variogram (the fitted-variogram diagnostics).

See also
